items: STURDY & DURABLE - The SPECSTAR engine support bar is made of high-quality steel with a protective powder-coated finish, which is in high rigidity and wear-resistant; The heavy duty materials are reliable that can decrease the loss and ensure safe operation and prolonged usage

STRONG LOAD CAPACITY - This transverse bar can carry up to 1100 lbs. that is suitable for lifting up and down of almost all types of car engines including sports cars, SUVs, sedans, and so on; It can precisely locate and support the engine, making repair and clean become easier

ACCURATE FINE-TUNING HEIGHT - The lifting height of 2 rotating hoists on the engine holder bar can be adjusted from 0 to 7.9 inches, and it is available to maintain altitude for a long time; Equipped with a knob and stable triangular base on each side, the range between the 2 bases can also be changed from 21 to 57 inches, so it applies to vehicles that width is less than 57 inch

PREMIUM FEATURES - The overall dimension of this solid engine brace is 57” (L) x 8.7” (W) x 7.9” (H); It comes with double strong iron chains that ensure the safe landing of the motor, which is handy for doing engine mounting; The non-slip thickened rubber feet on the bottom of the triangular base can effectively reduce noise when moving and prevent scratches on the car

EASY TO OPERATE - First, place black triangle support bases in the appropriate position, then fasten the engine with iron chains, and turn rotating hoists to raise or lower the motor to the proper height based on your needs; Designed with rubber materials on round knobs and hoist handles, which can protect your hands in use
